course.title: Applied Economics BSc | ELTE
quotes: Applicants need to submit their secondary school certificate and records of final two years in secondary school .
Certification of English knowledge (both written and oral): B2 Types of language exams which are accepted: IELTS Score: 5.5
Applicants with a complete application package will be notified about the exact time and date of their online interviews after the application period has ended.

living.title: FAQ for prospective students | ELTE Faculty of Science
quotes: Here’s a general breakdown of typical monthly expenses for international students.
Utilities (electricity, water, heating, internet): €50–€100 per month, if not included in the rent.

program.name: Applied Economics
program.summary: Applied Economics (BSc), ELTE Budapest, taught in English.

costs.note: EUR 2,700 per semester (course page, September 2027/28 intake); 6 semesters over 3 years, so the yearly figure is our calculation.

living.note: Our calculation from the top of each monthly range in ELTE's Faculty of Science guide: accommodation EUR 500, utilities EUR 100, food EUR 250, public transport EUR 30, health insurance EUR 50, other EUR 150, × 12 = EUR 12,960 a year.

admissions.threshold: Applied Economics: no grade cut-off published; secondary school certificate and final two years' records, motivation letter, and an online interview.

english.min_score: B2: IELTS 5.5 (or the other certificates ELTE lists).
